statement_keys.ab-fire: A and B fire the fighter's missiles.
statement_keys.start-pause: START starts/stops the game and pauses play.
statement_keys.player-select: SELECT chooses one or two players.
statement_keys.challenge-every-3: Every third level has a challenging stage.
statement_keys.retrieve-fighters: Retrieve captured fighters from the Commander tractor-beam.
statement_keys.double-fire-power: Retrieving a captured fighter doubles your fire power.
statement_keys.boss-two-hits: It takes two hits to destroy the boss Galaga.
statement_keys.score-defeat-galaga: The player gets points by defeating Galaga.
